title: ID0419305-DC/Si-D/NL[9paoWH&JGQcg6] - Update FW and OCPP offline
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Update chargers and check OCPP offline
Solution:
SIM not inserted → replace SIM card

additional_info.subject: Update FW 9paoWH and JGQcg6
additional_info.body:
Hi colleagues,
Could you please update 9paoWH and JGQcg6 to the latest FW versions? These are the chargers at our own offices.
JGQcg6 doesn’t seem to connect to OCPP, if this stays like this after the update, could you look into why it doesn’t connect?
9paoWH had its outlets unavailable. I did a reboot just now to see if that helps. If this stays like this after the reboot and update, could you look into they’re unavailable?
With best regards,

additional_info.subject: ID0419305-DC/Si-D/NL[9paoWH&JGQcg6] - Update FW and OCPP offline CRM:00315002574
additional_info.body:
Hi Thomas,
Both chargers are now in v6.1.3. Are you going to the office tomorrow to check the SIM?
In any case, do you prefer to keep this ticket open? I will go on vacation at the end of tomorrow.
If SIM doesn't work, test with your mobile to confirm if there is no SIM issue.
If there is no problem with the SIM and still OCPP doesn't connect, make sure that the OCPP values are correct and replace the router if necessary.
Let me know your questions.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
